sources.quote: puts retail e-commerce at roughly $4 billion a month, about 6% of total retail sales
sources.title: The Daily — Retail trade, December 2025
sources.evidence: In December 2025, retail e-commerce sales on a seasonally adjusted basis increased 3.6% to $4.3 billion, accounting for 6.1% of total retail trade, compared with 5.8% in November.

sources.quote: Canadian Internet Use Survey found about 8 in 10 Canadians bought goods or services online in the survey year
sources.title: Online shopping in Canada in 2020: Results from Canadian Internet Use Survey
sources.evidence: 82% of Canadians shopped online in 2020, versus 77% in 2018. Canadians spent a total of $84.4 billion online, versus $57.4 billion in 2018.

sources.quote: courier de minimis is $150 duty-free and $40 tax-free for US and Mexican goods under CUSMA and only $20 otherwise
sources.title: Increase to low-value shipment thresholds and other changes
sources.evidence: CUSMA Article 7.8(1)(f) sets de minimis threshold for courier shipments from the US or Mexico of at least $150 for customs duties, and $40 for taxes. Goods imported to Canada from countries other than the United States and Mexico continue to have a duty and tax remission threshold value of up to $20.

sources.quote: at 51% or more of direct costs plus the last substantial transformation here
sources.title: Made in Canada claims - Competition Bureau Canada
sources.evidence: The Competition Bureau will generally not challenge a Made in Canada claim if at least 51% of the total direct costs of producing or manufacturing the good have been incurred in Canada, the last substantial transformation of the good occurred in Canada, and the claim is accompanied by an appropriate qualifying statement. For Product of Canada claims, at least 98% of the total direct costs must have been incurred in Canada.

sources.quote: Cineplex was ordered to pay roughly $39 million in 2024 over a booking fee, upheld on appeal in January 2026
sources.title: Statement from the Acting Commissioner of Competition on appeal court's ruling in Cineplex deceptive marketing case - Canada.ca
sources.evidence: On January 21, 2026, the Federal Court of Appeal dismissed Cineplex's appeal, with costs, upholding the September 2024 ruling by the Competition Tribunal that Cineplex engaged in drip pricing; the Tribunal ordered Cineplex to pay a financial penalty of over $38.9 million.

sources.quote: Register for GST/HST once worldwide taxable sales pass $30,000 in four consecutive quarters
sources.title: When to register for and start charging the GST/HST - Canada.ca
sources.evidence: You are no longer a small supplier and you must register for the GST/HST if your total revenues from taxable supplies are over $30,000 in a single calendar quarter or over the last four consecutive calendar quarters.

sources.quote: AODA requires WCAG 2.0 AA websites for private organisations of 50 or more employees
sources.title: How to make websites accessible
sources.evidence: As of January 1, 2021, the AODA requires you to make all public websites accessible if you are either a designated public sector organization or a business or non-profit organization with 50 or more employees. Your public website and web content posted after January 1, 2012, must meet the WCAG 2.0 Level AA success criteria.

sources.quote: a non-French trademark on packaging is exempt only if registered under the federal Trademarks Act, with older stock allowed until June 1, 2027
sources.publisher: Office québécois de la langue française
sources.title: Entreprises : marque de commerce sur les produits
sources.evidence: New rules concerning trademarks on products have been in force since June 1, 2025. A trademark recognized under the Trademarks Act may appear on a product, packaging or accompanying document only in a language other than French. Until June 1, 2027, a product with a trademark containing a generic term or descriptive in a language other than French can be marketed if it was manufactured before June 1, 2025 and no French version of the trademark was filed by June 26, 2024.
